testDrills: One failed DM normal drag and approximately 10 arrow tiles
One player-owned drag while a separate player watches for flashing
captureMethod: Keep query parameter during logged-in campaign route. After each drill capture JSON.stringify(window.__worldV2Trace.snapshot()) via browser DevTools Console, then clear() for next role. Prefer separate browser profiles, never copy network response bodies or auth tokens.

triageRules.signal: movement.grabbed then authority.begin high or rejected; no approved
observer resync, gaps or unknown-piece correlates with flashing
triageRules.focus: private observer stream and signed sight choreography

triageRules.signal: preview worse but no authority RPC
triageRules.focus: preview sight round trips, local renderer or input, not public motion write path

gate: No deploy until evidence differentiates input, server, private observer and renderer failures; no speculative R05 migration
dataHandling: Trace is bounded and enumerated: no actor ids, coords, JWTs, raw RPC payloads, hidden identities or secrets
